scene.label: Act 2, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. Another part of the wood

lines.text: Come, now a roundel and a fairy song;
lines.plainText: Come now a roundel and a fairy song

lines.text: Then for the third part of a minute, hence;
lines.plainText: Then for the third part of a minute hence

lines.text: Some to kill cankers in the musk-rose buds;
lines.plainText: Some to kill cankers in the muskrose buds

lines.text: Some war with reremice for their leathern wings,
lines.plainText: Some war with reremice for their leathern wings

lines.text: To make my small elves coats; and some keep back
lines.plainText: To make my small elves coats and some keep back

lines.text: The clamorous owl, that nightly hoots and wonders
lines.plainText: The clamorous owl that nightly hoots and wonders

lines.text: At our quaint spirits. Sing me now asleep;
lines.plainText: At our quaint spirits Sing me now asleep

lines.text: Then to your offices, and let me rest.
lines.plainText: Then to your offices and let me rest

lines.text: You spotted snakes with double tongue,
lines.plainText: You spotted snakes with double tongue

lines.text: Thorny hedgehogs, be not seen;
lines.plainText: Thorny hedgehogs be not seen

lines.text: Newts and blind-worms do no wrong,
lines.plainText: Newts and blindworms do no wrong

lines.text: Come not near our Fairy Queen:
lines.plainText: Come not near our Fairy Queen

lines.text: Philomel, with melody,
lines.plainText: Philomel with melody

lines.text: Sing in our sweet lullaby:
lines.plainText: Sing in our sweet lullaby

lines.text: Lulla, lulla, lullaby; lulla, lulla, lullaby.
lines.plainText: Lulla lulla lullaby lulla lulla lullaby

lines.text: Never harm, nor spell, nor charm,
lines.plainText: Never harm nor spell nor charm

lines.text: Come our lovely lady nigh;
lines.plainText: Come our lovely lady nigh

lines.text: So good night, with lullaby.
lines.plainText: So good night with lullaby

lines.text: Weaving spiders, come not here;
lines.plainText: Weaving spiders come not here

lines.text: Hence, you long-legg'd spinners, hence.
lines.plainText: Hence you longlegg'd spinners hence

lines.text: Beetles black, approach not near;
lines.plainText: Beetles black approach not near

lines.text: Worm nor snail do no offence.
lines.plainText: Worm nor snail do no offence

lines.text: Philomel with melody, &c.
lines.plainText: Philomel with melody c

lines.text: Hence away! Now all is well.
lines.plainText: Hence away Now all is well

lines.text: One aloof stand sentinel.
lines.plainText: One aloof stand sentinel

lines.text: What thou seest when thou dost wake,
lines.plainText: What thou seest when thou dost wake

lines.text: Fair love, you faint with wand'ring in the wood.
lines.plainText: Fair love you faint with wand'ring in the wood

lines.text: And, to speak troth, I have forgot our way.
lines.plainText: And to speak troth I have forgot our way

lines.text: We'll rest us, Hermia, if you think it good,
lines.plainText: We'll rest us Hermia if you think it good

lines.text: And tarry for the comfort of the day.
lines.plainText: And tarry for the comfort of the day

lines.text: Be it so, Lysander: find you out a bed,
lines.plainText: Be it so Lysander find you out a bed

lines.text: For I upon this bank will rest my head.
lines.plainText: For I upon this bank will rest my head

lines.text: One turf shall serve as pillow for us both;
lines.plainText: One turf shall serve as pillow for us both

lines.text: One heart, one bed, two bosoms, and one troth.
lines.plainText: One heart one bed two bosoms and one troth

lines.text: Nay, good Lysander; for my sake, my dear,
lines.plainText: Nay good Lysander for my sake my dear

lines.text: Lie further off yet, do not lie so near.
lines.plainText: Lie further off yet do not lie so near

lines.text: O take the sense, sweet, of my innocence!
lines.plainText: O take the sense sweet of my innocence

lines.text: Love takes the meaning in love's conference.
lines.plainText: Love takes the meaning in love's conference

lines.text: I mean that my heart unto yours is knit,
lines.plainText: I mean that my heart unto yours is knit

lines.text: So that but one heart we can make of it:
lines.plainText: So that but one heart we can make of it

lines.text: Two bosoms interchainèd with an oath,
lines.plainText: Two bosoms interchaind with an oath

lines.text: So then two bosoms and a single troth.
lines.plainText: So then two bosoms and a single troth

lines.text: Then by your side no bed-room me deny;
lines.plainText: Then by your side no bedroom me deny

lines.text: For lying so, Hermia, I do not lie.
lines.plainText: For lying so Hermia I do not lie

lines.text: Lysander riddles very prettily.
lines.plainText: Lysander riddles very prettily

lines.text: Now much beshrew my manners and my pride,
lines.plainText: Now much beshrew my manners and my pride

lines.text: If Hermia meant to say Lysander lied!
lines.plainText: If Hermia meant to say Lysander lied

lines.text: But, gentle friend, for love and courtesy
lines.plainText: But gentle friend for love and courtesy

lines.text: Lie further off, in human modesty,
lines.plainText: Lie further off in human modesty

lines.text: Such separation as may well be said
lines.plainText: Such separation as may well be said

lines.text: Becomes a virtuous bachelor and a maid,
lines.plainText: Becomes a virtuous bachelor and a maid

lines.text: So far be distant; and good night, sweet friend:
lines.plainText: So far be distant and good night sweet friend

lines.text: Thy love ne'er alter till thy sweet life end!
lines.plainText: Thy love ne'er alter till thy sweet life end

lines.text: Amen, amen, to that fair prayer say I;
lines.plainText: Amen amen to that fair prayer say I

lines.text: And then end life when I end loyalty!
lines.plainText: And then end life when I end loyalty

lines.text: Here is my bed. Sleep give thee all his rest!
lines.plainText: Here is my bed Sleep give thee all his rest

lines.text: With half that wish the wisher's eyes be pressed!
lines.plainText: With half that wish the wisher's eyes be pressed

lines.text: Through the forest have I gone,
lines.plainText: Through the forest have I gone

lines.text: But Athenian found I none,
lines.plainText: But Athenian found I none

lines.text: On whose eyes I might approve
lines.plainText: On whose eyes I might approve

lines.text: This flower's force in stirring love.
lines.plainText: This flower's force in stirring love

lines.text: Night and silence! Who is here?
lines.plainText: Night and silence Who is here

lines.text: Weeds of Athens he doth wear:
lines.plainText: Weeds of Athens he doth wear

lines.text: This is he, my master said,
lines.plainText: This is he my master said

lines.text: Despisèd the Athenian maid;
lines.plainText: Despisd the Athenian maid

lines.text: And here the maiden, sleeping sound,
lines.plainText: And here the maiden sleeping sound

lines.text: On the dank and dirty ground.
lines.plainText: On the dank and dirty ground

lines.text: Pretty soul, she durst not lie
lines.plainText: Pretty soul she durst not lie

lines.text: Near this lack-love, this kill-courtesy.
lines.plainText: Near this lacklove this killcourtesy

lines.text: Churl, upon thy eyes I throw
lines.plainText: Churl upon thy eyes I throw

lines.text: All the power this charm doth owe;
lines.plainText: All the power this charm doth owe

lines.text: When thou wak'st let love forbid
lines.plainText: When thou wak'st let love forbid

lines.text: Sleep his seat on thy eyelid.
lines.plainText: Sleep his seat on thy eyelid

lines.text: So awake when I am gone;
lines.plainText: So awake when I am gone

lines.text: For I must now to Oberon.
lines.plainText: For I must now to Oberon

lines.text: Stay, though thou kill me, sweet Demetrius.
lines.plainText: Stay though thou kill me sweet Demetrius

lines.text: I charge thee, hence, and do not haunt me thus.
lines.plainText: I charge thee hence and do not haunt me thus

lines.text: O, wilt thou darkling leave me? Do not so.
lines.plainText: O wilt thou darkling leave me Do not so

lines.text: Stay, on thy peril; I alone will go.
lines.plainText: Stay on thy peril I alone will go

lines.text: O, I am out of breath in this fond chase!
lines.plainText: O I am out of breath in this fond chase

lines.text: The more my prayer, the lesser is my grace.
lines.plainText: The more my prayer the lesser is my grace

lines.text: Happy is Hermia, wheresoe'er she lies,
lines.plainText: Happy is Hermia wheresoe'er she lies

lines.text: For she hath blessèd and attractive eyes.
lines.plainText: For she hath blessd and attractive eyes

lines.text: How came her eyes so bright? Not with salt tears.
lines.plainText: How came her eyes so bright Not with salt tears

lines.text: If so, my eyes are oftener wash'd than hers.
lines.plainText: If so my eyes are oftener wash'd than hers

lines.text: No, no, I am as ugly as a bear,
lines.plainText: No no I am as ugly as a bear

lines.text: For beasts that meet me run away for fear:
lines.plainText: For beasts that meet me run away for fear

lines.text: Therefore no marvel though Demetrius
lines.plainText: Therefore no marvel though Demetrius

lines.text: Do, as a monster, fly my presence thus.
lines.plainText: Do as a monster fly my presence thus

lines.text: What wicked and dissembling glass of mine
lines.plainText: What wicked and dissembling glass of mine

lines.text: Made me compare with Hermia's sphery eyne?
lines.plainText: Made me compare with Hermia's sphery eyne

lines.text: But who is here? Lysander, on the ground!
lines.plainText: But who is here Lysander on the ground

lines.text: Dead or asleep? I see no blood, no wound.
lines.plainText: Dead or asleep I see no blood no wound

lines.text: Lysander, if you live, good sir, awake.
lines.plainText: Lysander if you live good sir awake

lines.text: [Waking.] And run through fire I will for thy sweet sake.
lines.plainText: Waking And run through fire I will for thy sweet sake

lines.text: Transparent Helena! Nature shows art,
lines.plainText: Transparent Helena Nature shows art

lines.text: That through thy bosom makes me see thy heart.
lines.plainText: That through thy bosom makes me see thy heart

lines.text: Where is Demetrius? O, how fit a word
lines.plainText: Where is Demetrius O how fit a word

lines.text: Is that vile name to perish on my sword!
lines.plainText: Is that vile name to perish on my sword

lines.text: Do not say so, Lysander, say not so.
lines.plainText: Do not say so Lysander say not so

lines.text: What though he love your Hermia? Lord, what though?
lines.plainText: What though he love your Hermia Lord what though

lines.text: Yet Hermia still loves you. Then be content.
lines.plainText: Yet Hermia still loves you Then be content

lines.text: Content with Hermia? No, I do repent
lines.plainText: Content with Hermia No I do repent

lines.text: The tedious minutes I with her have spent.
lines.plainText: The tedious minutes I with her have spent

lines.text: Not Hermia, but Helena I love.
lines.plainText: Not Hermia but Helena I love

lines.text: Who will not change a raven for a dove?
lines.plainText: Who will not change a raven for a dove

lines.text: The will of man is by his reason sway'd,
lines.plainText: The will of man is by his reason sway'd

lines.text: And reason says you are the worthier maid.
lines.plainText: And reason says you are the worthier maid

lines.text: Things growing are not ripe until their season;
lines.plainText: Things growing are not ripe until their season

lines.text: So I, being young, till now ripe not to reason;
lines.plainText: So I being young till now ripe not to reason

lines.text: And touching now the point of human skill,
lines.plainText: And touching now the point of human skill

lines.text: Reason becomes the marshal to my will,
lines.plainText: Reason becomes the marshal to my will

lines.text: And leads me to your eyes, where I o'erlook
lines.plainText: And leads me to your eyes where I o'erlook

lines.text: Love's stories, written in love's richest book.
lines.plainText: Love's stories written in love's richest book

lines.text: Wherefore was I to this keen mockery born?
lines.plainText: Wherefore was I to this keen mockery born

lines.text: When at your hands did I deserve this scorn?
lines.plainText: When at your hands did I deserve this scorn

lines.text: Is't not enough, is't not enough, young man,
lines.plainText: Is't not enough is't not enough young man

lines.text: That I did never, no, nor never can
lines.plainText: That I did never no nor never can

lines.text: Deserve a sweet look from Demetrius' eye,
lines.plainText: Deserve a sweet look from Demetrius' eye

lines.text: But you must flout my insufficiency?
lines.plainText: But you must flout my insufficiency

lines.text: Good troth, you do me wrong, good sooth, you do,
lines.plainText: Good troth you do me wrong good sooth you do

lines.text: In such disdainful manner me to woo.
lines.plainText: In such disdainful manner me to woo

lines.text: But fare you well; perforce I must confess,
lines.plainText: But fare you well perforce I must confess

lines.text: I thought you lord of more true gentleness.
lines.plainText: I thought you lord of more true gentleness

lines.text: O, that a lady of one man refus'd,
lines.plainText: O that a lady of one man refus'd

lines.text: Should of another therefore be abus'd!
lines.plainText: Should of another therefore be abus'd

lines.text: She sees not Hermia. Hermia, sleep thou there,
lines.plainText: She sees not Hermia Hermia sleep thou there

lines.text: And never mayst thou come Lysander near!
lines.plainText: And never mayst thou come Lysander near

lines.text: For, as a surfeit of the sweetest things
lines.plainText: For as a surfeit of the sweetest things

lines.text: The deepest loathing to the stomach brings;
lines.plainText: The deepest loathing to the stomach brings

lines.text: Or as the heresies that men do leave
lines.plainText: Or as the heresies that men do leave

lines.text: Are hated most of those they did deceive;
lines.plainText: Are hated most of those they did deceive

lines.text: So thou, my surfeit and my heresy,
lines.plainText: So thou my surfeit and my heresy

lines.text: Of all be hated, but the most of me!
lines.plainText: Of all be hated but the most of me

lines.text: And, all my powers, address your love and might
lines.plainText: And all my powers address your love and might

lines.text: To honour Helen, and to be her knight!
lines.plainText: To honour Helen and to be her knight

lines.text: [Starting.] Help me, Lysander, help me! Do thy best
lines.plainText: Starting Help me Lysander help me Do thy best

lines.text: To pluck this crawling serpent from my breast!
lines.plainText: To pluck this crawling serpent from my breast

lines.text: Ay me, for pity! What a dream was here!
lines.plainText: Ay me for pity What a dream was here

lines.text: Lysander, look how I do quake with fear.
lines.plainText: Lysander look how I do quake with fear

lines.text: Methought a serpent eat my heart away,
lines.plainText: Methought a serpent eat my heart away

lines.text: And you sat smiling at his cruel prey.
lines.plainText: And you sat smiling at his cruel prey

lines.text: Lysander! What, removed? Lysander! lord!
lines.plainText: Lysander What removed Lysander lord

lines.text: What, out of hearing? Gone? No sound, no word?
lines.plainText: What out of hearing Gone No sound no word

lines.text: Alack, where are you? Speak, and if you hear;
lines.plainText: Alack where are you Speak and if you hear

lines.text: Speak, of all loves! I swoon almost with fear.
lines.plainText: Speak of all loves I swoon almost with fear

lines.text: No? Then I well perceive you are not nigh.
lines.plainText: No Then I well perceive you are not nigh

lines.text: Either death or you I'll find immediately.
lines.plainText: Either death or you I'll find immediately
